image_description: A wooden, wall-mounted aneroid barometer with a distinctive wavy or serpentine silhouette. It features a circular dial at the top with a brass bezel and a glass cover. The dial face is white with black text reading 'BAROMETER' and numerical markings. Below the dial are two vertical rectangular windows containing brass mechanisms (likely thermometers or hygrometers). The casing is polished wood, mounted on a textured, cream-colored wall.
